'''Takai''' will be the Miagoma Clan Chief in one of [[Aviendha]]'s visions of the future in the [[Glass columns]] ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in [[Rhuidean]], 

==History and Activities==
He is the third Clan Chief of the Miagoma in as many years.

He took part in the [[Council of Twenty Two]].

He is the youngest of the Clan Chiefs in the meeting with [[Ladalin]], [[Mora (Goshien)|Mora]], [[Tamaav]] and [[Jorshem]], twenty years after the [[Seanchan]] gained the [[Dragons|Andoran war machines]]. 

He blames [[Rand]] for abandoning them and that their honor was taken from them, that there is no point being the [[People of the Dragon]] if they are just to be cast away.

==Errata and Origin==
He is also mentioned in the Companion entries for [[Ladalin]] and [[Mora (Goshien)|Mora]] as ''Takei''. The Thirteenth Depository blog previously speculated the character, as Takai, could be named after [[wikipedia:George Takei|George Takei]], but it is unclear if this is the case or just a typo because Takei is a more well-known spelling.<ref>[http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Characters Names Derived from Readers]</ref>
